个人环境设计 · personal-environment-design

中文指南

Design the connected surfaces through which a person understands, chooses, acts, and returns to work. This Skill examines cognitive and interaction effort across websites, desktops, launchers, applications, documents, and automation. It preserves meaningful distinctions while reducing unnecessary coordination.

Use and capabilities

Copy the complete directory into a Skill location supported by your agent host. There are no mandatory software dependencies or companion Skills. Investigation can begin with supplied descriptions; observing or changing a real environment requires the recipient's actual browser, desktop, application, or implementation tools and existing permissions. The Skill does not create those capabilities.

Example request: “I start in a launcher, open a project dashboard, then search three documents to remember what to do next. Inspect that journey and implement a clearer way to resume the project.” The method follows the real path, separates observed friction from hypotheses, compares existing controls with new surfaces, implements through the system's owner, and verifies the affected journey.

It considers understanding, operating, coordinating, and recovering together. Fewer clicks or a sparse screen are insufficient evidence of improvement. A useful result explains what the person must find, remember, decide, enter, switch, wait for, and recover, along with any burden transferred elsewhere. Model walkthroughs remain distinct from measured human use.

Package and adaptation

SKILL.md is the English model-facing method. Design basis retains reusable distinctions and public design references. The aligned README editions explain adoption. This public adaptation generalizes the original local method's tool routing and replaces private originating quotations and conversation identifiers with standalone design rationale. It includes no personal history or private sources.

This independent package uses the MIT License. Linked external references retain their own rights; their full texts are not bundled.
